dingle_skipper.text: An Faoileán Beag. The little gull. She is small, but she has never once let me down on a Tuesday.
Rates, bait, weather: the three things a skipper curses on the walk to the quay.

dingle_hand.text: Visitors ask where the dolphin went. I tell them he is on holiday. Nobody has ever argued.
Pollack off the rocks in spring and mackerel in the summer. Bring a flask.
